{{Top}}
A '''control tower''' was a type of structure from which traffic was monitored.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> In some cases it was possible to pilot a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] from a control tower if a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] had used the [[emergency override]].

By [[Imperial Space Ministry]]-standard, any [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] without a control tower was classified as a 'Landing Field'.<ref name="GG6.2">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>
